ev.q: SOURCE: Heron MP, Hoyert DL, Xu JQ, Scott C, Tejada-Vera B. Deaths: preliminary data for 2006.
Age-adjusted death rates for diabetes declined for whites and blacks from 2005 to 2006.
The rate for black males, however, has generally increased and first surpassed the rate for black females in 2001.

methods_quotes.q: death rates before 1999 are not exactly comparable with those computed after 1998.
